items.title: Manual vs. automated recovery time, as the pipeline grows
items.description: A manual deploy creates two risks as the process grows: more time to recover by hand, and more chances for at least one required step to be skipped or reordered. Drag the step count to see both gaps: automation keeps recovery fixed and makes the step list enforceable instead of remembered.

params.name: stepCount
params.label: Number of steps in the deploy process

params.name: humanErrorPercent
params.label: Chance one manual step is missed

items.compute: const p = params.humanErrorPercent / 100; const omittedStepRiskPercent = Math.round((1 - Math.pow(1 - p, params.stepCount)) * 1000) / 10; return { manualSeconds: params.stepCount * params.secondsPerStep, automatedSeconds: 10, omittedStepRiskPercent };

outputs.label: Chance at least one manual step is missed
